basic preprod/preprod internet.detail: handbook §'Phase 11' has the exact block. In short: enroll YOUR laptop (netbird up), pin the three dashboard hosts in /etc/hosts, read the one-time password from /opt/mgmt-host/.bootstrap-passwords/$OWNER_EMAIL.txt, log in; re-run the phase-10 dashboard-deploy line ONCE (promotes you to admin — the UI 403s until then); create service user svc-preprod-netbird-infra (Team > Service Users, role admin), create its token, add 'export PREPROD_NB_API_TOKEN=<token>' to .envrc.local.d/30-site-services.envrc and store it in 1Password as preprod-netbird / api_token. Read the one-time password from /opt/mgmt-host/.bootstrap-passwords/$OWNER_EMAIL.txt on the host, log in; re-run the phase-10 LAN service line ONCE (promotes you to admin — the UI 403s until then); create service user svc-alpha-netbird-infra (Team > Service Users, role admin), create its token, and store it as ALPHA_NB_API_TOKEN under the declared secrets posture (posture.py hint ALPHA_NB_API_TOKEN says where). THEN resume: goatbuilder standup zagros --site alpha --from 12

goatnet-from-scratch/02-first-federated-.name: cmd
goatnet-from-scratch/02-first-federated-.detail: handbook §'Phase 11' has the exact block. In short: enroll YOUR laptop (netbird up), pin the three dashboard hosts in /etc/hosts, read the one-time password from /opt/mgmt-host/.bootstrap-passwords/$OWNER_EMAIL.txt, log in; re-run the phase-10 dashboard-deploy line ONCE (promotes you to admin — the UI 403s until then); create service user svc-alpha-netbird-infra (Team > Service Users, role admin), create its token, add 'export ALPHA_NB_API_TOKEN=<token>' to .envrc.local.d/30-site-services.envrc and store it in 1Password as alpha-netbird / api_token. THEN resume: goatbuilder standup zagros --site alpha --from 12

standup dev/alpha lan.name: phase
standup dev/alpha lan.detail: === Phase 11 [MANUAL] [lan] first login, admin-promote, the bootstrap NetBird token ===

standup dev/alpha lan.name: cmd
standup dev/alpha lan.detail: handbook §'Phase 11' has the exact block; on a LAN site the dashboard is the dashboard.* name under this site's zone (site_dns_zone in group_vars/alpha_hosts/vars.yml), resolved by the host's LAN CoreDNS: point the laptop's DNS at the host or pin the names in /etc/hosts. Read the one-time password from /opt/mgmt-host/.bootstrap-passwords/$OWNER_EMAIL.txt on the host, log in; re-run the phase-10 LAN service line ONCE (promotes you to admin — the UI 403s until then); create service user svc-alpha-netbird-infra (Team > Service Users, role admin), create its token, and store it as ALPHA_NB_API_TOKEN under the declared secrets posture (posture.py hint ALPHA_NB_API_TOKEN says where). THEN resume: goatbuilder standup dev --site alpha --from 12
